evidence.curator_note: Left column of Equation 8.82, vertical arrow labelled 'r H, a': the distonic ion .CH2-(CH2)n-1-C(=O)-O(+)(H)CH3 back-bites -- its terminal primary radical C(6) abstracts the explicitly drawn H from the carbon alpha to the ester carbonyl, C(2), through a six-membered transition state (with n = 5: C6-C5-C4-C3-C2 plus the H), and the resulting C(2) radical then alpha-cleaves the C(3)-C(4) bond to give the drawn products, the alkyl radical CH3(CH2)n-3. (n-propyl for n = 5) and the even-electron protonated methyl acrylate CH2=CH-C(=O)-O(+)(H)CH3. Book draws 4 arc(s), all single-barb fishhooks: (i) the long hook from the 'H2C.' radical dot to the alpha C-H, (ii) a hook from that C-H bond pointing back left (the H leaving with one electron), (iii) a second hook from the same C-H bond down into the C(2)-C(3) bond, and (iv) a hook from the C(3)-C(4) bond up into the C(2)-C(3) bond. Arcs (i)-(iii) all involve the migrating hydrogen, which cannot carry an atom map, so at heavy-atom level they collapse into the single move <1> = the odd electron flowing from C(6) into the forming C(2)=C(3) pi bond; arc (iv) is move <2>. Move <3>, the hook that leaves the other C(3)-C(4) electron on C(4) as the drawn neutral radical, is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). INSTANTIATION (the scheme is generic in R and in the chain length n): R = CH3 and n = 5, i.e. methyl 7-hydroxyoctanoate CH3-CH(OH)-(CH2)5-C(=O)-OCH3 (C9H18O3, M+. m/z 174.1250). n = 5 is the smallest chain that makes the final 'rH, a' step of this same scheme proceed through the favoured six-membered transition state, and it keeps the book's (CH2)n-3 label meaningful ((CH2)2). NO m/z and NO percentage is printed anywhere in Equation 8.82 except 'm/z 55' on the last product; every other mass in these records is the curator's computed monoisotopic value for this instantiation, not a measured number.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for 8.82 (the index stops at 8.14 for Chapter 8), so no MOD rule is cross-linked to this record. hTransition_saturated_2 '[H]1[C]2[C]3([_A+]4)[C]5[C.]6>>[C.]2[C]3([_A+]4)[C]5[C]6([H]1)' is the only indexed rule that transfers an H onto a CARBON radical terminus, but it was checked and does not match: it is a 1,4-shift whose onium [_A+] hangs off the middle of the donor-acceptor chain, whereas here the charge sits on the ester oxygen OUTSIDE the five-atom H-transfer chain, the shift is a 1,5-shift, and the rule performs no C-C cleavage at all (its partner hTransition_saturated_2_alpha then cleaves the bond next to the charged site, not the bond beta to the carbonyl). Unmodelled.
